_comment: Coverage floors enforced by `bun run check:coverage-floor` and shape-checked by the audit-invariants `coverage_floor` check. `subsystems` are LOC-weighted directory aggregates; `files` are single files; `core_default` applies to every core.ts and core/** file not excluded. Bun reports no branch coverage, so branch_min is recorded but unmeasured.

apps/engine/src/rbac.rationale: RBAC mediates every authorisation decision; high coverage matches the highest enterprise-control-plane risk surface.

apps/engine/src/audit.rationale: Audit log is the immutable evidence trail for SOC2/ISO27001/GDPR; redaction, tenant scoping, and tx rollback are non-negotiable contracts.

apps/engine/src/identity.rationale: Identity covers OIDC, JWKS, JIT provisioning, portal tokens, sessions; the floor is below rbac/audit because some service-level paths only fire under live OIDC traffic that's covered by integration tests with real IdP fixtures.

apps/engine/src/auth.rationale: Auth providers (api_key, portal_token, oidc) gate every request; negative paths (revoked, expired, malformed, hash mismatch, not_yet_active) all pinned by tests.

apps/engine/src/credentials.rationale: Credential vault + OAuth2 refresh logic. Floor is set lower than auth because OAuth2 refresh loops include backoff/retry branches that fire only under flaky upstreams; raising this floor requires the OAuth2 fixture suite to grow.

apps/engine/src/connectors/drivers.rationale: Driver code is mostly thin adapters over external libraries; full integration coverage requires real services (testcontainers / docker-in-docker, tracked in the driver-integration follow-up). Unit-level coverage of DSN parsing, arg validation, and connection-failure paths is what the floor reflects today.

apps/engine/src/execution.rationale: DAG executor + step dispatch. The floor is below 80% because the large loop.ts / request.ts files still need decomposition that will reshape this surface; raise once that lands.

apps/engine/src/self-healing.rationale: Drift detection, classifier, fixture dry-run, approve/reject reviewer helpers. Loop test + approve-reject test together cover the main control flow.

apps/engine/src/scheduler.rationale: Cron reconciler with CAS-guarded exactly-once semantics; race + dedup tests pin the contract. Calendar-gate / trigger-bind paths are also covered.

apps/engine/src/http/routes.rationale: Route coverage is now enforced. The route boundary harness plus per-route tests pin Zod/RBAC/tenant/audit contracts; the floor sits three points under the observed LOC-weighted aggregate and should ratchet up as the large route files are split into per-resource files.

core_default.rationale: Pure cores take time, ids and randomness as parameters, so every line is reachable from a plain example or property test. llm/core is the provider adapter layer, not a pure core.

packages/shared/src/approval-choice.ts.rationale: Pure approval-choice mapping shared by engine, sk and cockpit; first Stryker target.
